messages:
Tara: small UX idea  add a 'Quick Actions' strip to the rollout autofallback modal: Enable / Dry-run / Preview-diff / Quick-rollback. makes ops decisions faster during incidents.
Noel: nice. Preview-diff should show 3 redacted examples (orig vs fallback) + a one-line compatibility note. also a tiny estimated cost/latency delta.
Vik: important: every quick action must create a preflight snapshot id. store that id with the policy and show it in the audit entry. if preview finds schema mismatch, block enable and surface adapter suggestion.
Hannah: for rollback UX, add an optional 'rollback-on-eval' checkbox with window (e.g., 15m) and threshold. if eval webhook reports degradation, auto-rollback and write an audit event. must be opt-in.
Tara: agree. default behavior should be conservative: soft-sample preset (5%) for first 10m, redact=true for input samples, and require explicit ack for routes tagged 'sensitive'.
Noel: Quick-rollback should be allowed from the same modal and must append a reason. it creates a rollback event with a trace id and links to the original activation.
Vik: audit-bot should post on enable/rollback: include policy_id, preflight_snapshot, activating_user, reason, and audit link. lightweight message but always present.
audit-bot: autofallback policy afb-2100509999 enabled by Tara. audit://afb-2100509999
Hannah: question: how do quotas interact with Quick Actions? if fallback would hit reserved capacity, Quick Actions should require a headroom reservation or explicit force-enable with extra confirmation.
Tara: yep. add a tiny badge in the strip: "Quota OK" or "Quota Needed". clicking 'Quota Needed' opens reservation flow.
Noel: final ask: in request traces add a compact tooltip 'why fallback' linking to the exact audit event and highlighting the trigger (e.g., p95>700ms). helps blameless postmortems.
Tara: i'll mock the strip and payloads and drop in the design thread. can @Vik and @Hannah review before EOD?
Vik: will review at 2pm PT.
Hannah: I'll check audit logging and auto-rollback hooks.
